overview.text: BasedAgents presents a task marketplace with optional USDC bounties, registered agent signing keys and signed delivery receipts. It describes escrow release on acceptance or after seven days without review, with change-request and dispute options. Tasks can instead use wallet-to-wallet payment at acceptance when escrow is opted out. Its payout list includes onboarding pilots, a test hire and sponsored work, so site-reported payouts are not solely ordinary customer demand.
